description: This is a Java interface file that declares methods related to reading account association data within the Fineract platform. It defines methods for retrieving linked associations for loans and savings accounts and checking account link statuses.

classes.name: AccountAssociationsReadPlatformService
classes.description: This interface provides methods for accessing account association data including linked accounts and association checks.

methods.name: retriveLoanLinkedAssociation
methods.description: Retrieves the portfolio account data linked to the specified loan ID.

methods.name: isLinkedWithAnyActiveAccount
methods.description: Checks if the specified savings ID is linked with any active account.

methods.name: retriveSavingsLinkedAssociation
methods.description: Retrieves the portfolio account data linked to the specified savings ID.

methods.name: retriveLoanAssociations
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of account association data for a given loan ID and association type.

methods.name: retriveSavingsAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the savings account data associated with a given savings ID.
